newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate closes lower on loose funds.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate closes lower on loose funds.

text.p: Taiwan's overnight interbank rate fell on Thursday on easing liquidity in the banking system, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate finished at 6.821 percent against Wednesday's 6.929 close -- still far outside the central bank's 5.00-5.5 percent target zone -- with 30-day commercial paper unchanged at 6.75 percent.
Dealers said some T$8 billion worth of negotiable certificates of deposit, which was due to mature on Friday, would flush more funds into the banking system.
The central bank's issuance on Thursday of T$3 billion in one-month NCDs absorbed only a small portion of excess funds from the banking system, dealers said.
Dealers expected the central bank to continue to issue NCDs to "modestly" mop up funds on Friday.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 government bond yields were traded at 6.0860-0870 percent in earlier session against Wednesday's 6.0903-0905 close.
No trade was reported in the afternoon.
